description: IBM Container Registry: namespaces and the images in them. A namespace must exist before the first push. Call get_schema with name icr for every action's fields.

action.description: namespaces: List registry namespaces in the account. | create_namespace: Create a namespace. Needs namespace. | images: List images, optionally in one namespace. | delete_image: Delete one image by tag or digest, e.g. us.icr.io/ns/app:v1. Needs image.

image.description: Full image reference to delete, e.g. us.icr.io/mynamespace/myapp:v1.0.0

namespace.description: Namespace name to create (lowercase, alphanumeric and hyphens)

name: icr
